However, the test failed because the loss value returned is `nan`, not zero. Upon examining the code snippet for `Model.train_on_batch`, we can see that it calls `_standardize_user_data()` to prepare the inputs and weights. After that, it makes a call to `self.train_function(ins)`. The error might be occurring within these methods or in the `train_function` method itself.

Keras.engine.training.Model._standardize_user_data
Keras.engine.training.Model.train_function
